_hosts_why: WHERE THIS RECIPE MAY RUN. Checked against the page hostname before the recipe is ever considered, goal match or not. This is not decoration: without it the practice recipe ran on irctc.co.in, matched From and To by luck, announced "Step 3 of 15" and then said "I am not sure" on somebody real booking page. Matching FAILS CLOSED - no hosts means the recipe runs nowhere.
label: Book a train ticket on Yatra Demo Rail
_comment: A recipe is a HINT and a SAFETY NET, not a script. The AI reads the live page on every step and writes the sentence itself; this file is passed to it as a clue, and is used verbatim only when the AI's answer is rejected. See extension/background.js for the validation gate. The say[] text here is the pre-written fallback phrasing.

say.en: Type where you are starting from
say.te: మీరు ఏ స్టేషన్ నుండి బయలుదేరుతున్నారో ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి

say.en: Now type the station you are going to
say.hi: यहाँ अपना पहुँचने वाला स्टेशन लिखिए
say.te: ఇప్పుడు వెళ్ళే స్టేషన్ ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి

steps._why: The dropdown already reads Sleeper, so field_filled would be true before the user did anything and the step would finish instantly.

say.en: Tap here to choose your class
say.hi: क्लास चुनने के लिए यहाँ दबाइए

say.en: Now press this Search Trains button
say.hi: अब यह Search Trains बटन दबाइए
say.te: ఇప్పుడు ఈ Search Trains బటన్ నొక్కండి

steps._why: Four identical Book buttons. Daari rings the first and says 'next to the train you want', because it cannot know which train was meant.

say.en: Press Book next to the train you want
say.hi: अपनी ट्रेन के आगे Book बटन दबाइए
say.te: మీ ట్రైన్ పక్కన Book బటన్ నొక్కండి

say.en: Type the ten digit mobile number here
say.hi: यहाँ दस अंकों का मोबाइल नंबर लिखिए
say.te: పది అంకెల మొబైల్ నంబర్ ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి

steps._why: Waits for the code to actually become VISIBLE, not just for the button to be clicked, so Daari does not move on if nothing happened.

say.en: The code is on the screen. Type it here yourself.
say.hi: कोड स्क्रीन पर है। उसे खुद यहाँ लिखिए।
say.te: కోడ్ స్క్రీన్ మీద ఉంది. దాన్ని మీరే ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి.

steps._why: Trips the confirm gate on the word 'payment', which is the gate working rather than misfiring. See safety.js.

say.en: Type your card number here yourself. I never read it.
say.hi: अपना कार्ड नंबर खुद यहाँ लिखिए। मैं उसे कभी नहीं पढ़ता।
say.te: మీ కార్డ్ నంబర్ మీరే ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి. నేను దాన్ని ఎప్పుడూ చదవను.

steps._why: Nothing to point at. The caption STAYS -- no auto-clear, because the PNR is the thing the user needs to write down.

say.en: Your PNR is on the screen. Well done!
say.hi: आपका PNR स्क्रीन पर है। बहुत बढ़िया!
say.te: మీ PNR స్క్రీన్ మీద ఉంది. బాగా చేశారు!

_on_reject_why: on_reject: which step to return to when the site refuses what was typed and the page does not move. A submit step completes ONLY on reaching the next page, never on the click, so a refusal leaves Daari standing on the submit step with nothing to do. It goes back to the step the complaint is about and says so. Default would be one step back, which is right for Pay but wrong for Search, where the rejection is about stations three steps earlier.
